title: MAPLE: Latent Multi-Agent Play for End-to-End Autonomous Driving
summary: Vision-language-action (VLA) models are effective as end-to-end motion planners, but can be brittle when evaluated in closed-loop settings due to being trained under traditional imitation learning framework. Existing closed-loop supervision approaches lack scalability and fail to completely model a reactive environment. We propose MAPLE, a novel framework for reactive, multi-agent rollout of a dynamic driving scenario in the latent space of the VLA model. The ego vehicle and nearby traffic agents are independently controlled over multi-step horizons, while being reactive to other agents in the scene, enabling closed-loop training. MAPLE consists of two training stages: (1) supervised fine-tuning on the latent rollouts based on ground-truth trajectories, followed by (2) reinforcement learning with global and agent -specific rewards that encourage safety, progress, and interaction realism. We further propose diversity rewards that encourage the model to generate planning behaviors that may not be present in logged driving data. Notably, our closed-loop training framework is scalable and does not require external simulators, which can be computationally expensive to run and have limited visual fidelity to the real-world. MAPLE achieves state-of-the-art driving performance on Bench2Drive and demonstrates scalable, closed-loop multi-agent play for robust E2E autonomous driving systems.
tldr: MAPLE proposes a scalable, closed-loop, multi-agent latent rollout framework for training end-to-end autonomous driving models, combining supervised fine-tuning and reinforcement learning without external simulators.
tldr_zh: MAPLE提出了一种可扩展的、闭环的、多智能体潜在状态展开框架，用于训练端到端自动驾驶模型，结合监督微调和强化学习，无需外部模拟器。
summary_zh: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型作为端到端运动规划器效果显著，但因其在传统模仿学习框架下训练，在闭环评估时易显脆弱。现有闭环监督方法缺乏可扩展性，且未能完全建模动态反应环境。我们提出MAPLE框架，该框架在VLA模型的潜在空间中实现动态驾驶场景的交互式多智能体推演。本车与周围交通参与者可在多步预测范围内独立控制，同时保持对场景中其他智能体的实时反应能力，从而实现闭环训练。MAPLE包含两个训练阶段：（1）基于真实轨迹的潜在空间推演监督微调，随后（2）结合全局与个体奖励的强化学习，以促进安全性、行驶进度与交互真实性。我们进一步提出多样性奖励机制，激励模型生成驾驶日志数据中未涵盖的规划行为。值得注意的是，该闭环训练框架具备可扩展性，无需依赖外部仿真器——这类仿真器通常计算成本高昂，且视觉保真度有限。MAPLE在Bench2Drive基准测试中实现了最先进的驾驶性能，展示了为鲁棒端到端自动驾驶系统构建的可扩展闭环多智能体协同机制。

title: Hand-in-the-Loop: Improving Dexterous VLA via Seamless Interventional Correction
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models are prone to compounding errors in dexterous manipulation, where high-dimensional action spaces and contact-rich dynamics amplify small policy deviations over long horizons. While Interactive Imitation Learning (IIL) can refine policies through human takeover data, applying it to high-degree-of-freedom (DoF) robotic hands remains challenging due to a command mismatch between human teleoperation and policy execution at the takeover moment, which causes abrupt robot-hand configuration changes, or "gesture jumps". We present Hand-in-the-Loop (HandITL), a seamless human-in-the-loop intervention method that blends human corrective intent with autonomous policy execution to avoid gesture jumps during bimanual dexterous manipulation. Compared with direct teleoperation takeover, HandITL reduces takeover jitter by 99.8% and preserves robust post-takeover manipulation, reducing grasp failures by 87.5% and mean completion time by 19.1%. We validate HandITL on tasks requiring bimanual coordination, tool use, and fine-grained long-horizon manipulation. When used to collect intervention data for policy refinement, HandITL yields policies that outperform those trained with standard teleoperation data by 19% on average across three long-horizon dexterous tasks.
tldr: Hand-in-the-Loop (HandITL) is a seamless human-in-the-loop intervention method for dexterous VLA models that blends human corrective intent with autonomous policy execution to avoid abrupt gesture jumps during bimanual manipulation, significantly improving performance and data efficiency for policy refinement.
tldr_zh: Hand-in-the-Loop（HandITL）是一种用于灵巧VLA模型的无缝人机交互干预方法，通过将人类校正意图与自主策略执行相结合，避免双臂操作中的手势突变，显著提升了策略性能和用于策略优化的数据效率。
summary_zh: 视觉-语言-动作模型在灵巧操作中容易产生累积误差，高维动作空间和密集接触动力学会在长时程中放大细微的策略偏差。虽然交互式模仿学习可通过人类接管数据优化策略，但将其应用于高自由度机械手仍面临挑战，原因在于人类遥操作与策略执行在接管时刻存在指令不匹配，这会导致机械手构型突然变化，即“手势跳变”。我们提出手部循环干预方法，该无缝人机交互干预技术将人类纠正意图与自主策略执行相融合，从而避免双手灵巧操作过程中的手势跳变。与直接遥操作接管相比，该方法将接管抖动降低99.8%，保持稳健的接管后操作性能，使抓握失败率降低87.5%，平均完成时间缩短19.1%。我们在需要双手协调、工具使用和细粒度长时程操作的任务中验证了该方法的有效性。当用于收集策略优化的干预数据时，基于此方法训练的策略在三个长时程灵巧任务中的平均表现优于传统遥操作数据训练策略19%。

title: Pelican-Unified 1.0: A Unified Embodied Intelligence Model for Understanding, Reasoning, Imagination and Action
summary:
We present Pelican-Unified 1.0, the first embodied foundation model trained according to the principle of unification. Pelican-Unified 1.0 uses a single VLM as a unified understanding module, mapping scenes, instructions, visual contexts, and action histories into a shared semantic space. The same VLM also serves as a unified reasoning module, autoregressively producing task-, action-, and future-oriented chains of thought in a single forward pass and projecting the final hidden state into a dense latent variable. A Unified Future Generator (UFG) then conditions on this latent variable and jointly generates future videos and future actions through two modality-specific output heads within the same denoising process. The language, video, and action losses are all backpropagated into the shared representation, enabling the model to jointly optimize understanding, reasoning, imagination, and action during training, rather than training three isolated expert systems.
  Experiments demonstrate that unification does not imply compromise. With a single checkpoint, Pelican-Unified 1.0 achieves strong performance across all three capabilities: 64.7 on eight VLM benchmarks, the best among comparable-scale models; 66.03 on WorldArena, ranking first; and 93.5 on RoboTwin, the second-best average among compared action methods. These results show that the unified paradigm succeeds in preserving specialist strength while bringing understanding, reasoning, imagination, and action into one model.
tldr: Pelican-Unified 1.0 is an embodied foundation model that unifies scene understanding, reasoning, imagination, and action prediction using a single VLM backbone and a unified future generator, achieving strong results across VLM, world model, and action benchmarks.
tldr_zh: Pelican-Unified 1.0 是一个统一的具身基础模型，它使用单个VLM作为核心，统一了场景理解、推理、想象和行动预测，在多个VLM、世界模型和行动基准测试中取得了优异成绩。
summary_zh:
我们提出Pelican-Unified 1.0——首个基于统一化原则训练的具身基础模型。该模型采用单一视觉语言模型作为统一理解模块，将场景、指令、视觉上下文与动作历史映射到共享语义空间。该视觉语言模型同时作为统一推理模块，通过单次前向传播自回归生成面向任务、动作与未来的思维链，并将最终隐藏状态投影为稠密潜变量。统一未来生成器随后以该潜变量为条件，在同一去噪过程中通过两个模态专用输出头联合生成未来视频与未来动作。语言、视频和动作损失均通过反向传播作用于共享表征，使得模型在训练中能够联合优化理解、推理、想象与行动能力，而非训练三个孤立的专家系统。

实验证明统一化并不意味性能折衷。在单一检查点下，Pelican-Unified 1.0在三大能力上均表现卓越：在八项视觉语言模型基准测试中达到64.7分，位居同规模模型首位；在WorldArena测试中获得66.03分，排名第一；在RoboTwin测试中取得93.5分，在对比的动作方法中位列第二。这些结果表明，统一范式成功保持了专业模型的优势，同时将理解、推理、想象与行动能力整合于单一模型中。

title: CLOVER: Closed-Loop Value Estimation \& Ranking for End-to-End Autonomous Driving Planning
summary: End-to-end autonomous driving planners are commonly trained by imitating a single logged trajectory, yet evaluated by rule-based planning metrics that measure safety, feasibility, progress, and comfort. This creates a training--evaluation mismatch: trajectories close to the logged path may violate planning rules, while alternatives farther from the demonstration can remain valid and high-scoring. The mismatch is especially limiting for proposal-selection planners, whose performance depends on candidate-set coverage and scorer ranking quality. We propose CLOVER, a Closed-LOop Value Estimation and Ranking framework for end-to-end autonomous driving planning. CLOVER follows a lightweight generator--scorer formulation: a generator produces diverse candidate trajectories, and a scorer predicts planning-metric sub-scores to rank them at inference time. To expand proposal support beyond single-trajectory imitation, CLOVER constructs evaluator-filtered pseudo-expert trajectories and trains the generator with set-level coverage supervision. It then performs conservative closed-loop self-distillation: the scorer is fitted to true evaluator sub-scores on generated proposals, while the generator is refined toward teacher-selected top-$k$ and vector-Pareto targets with stability regularization. We analyze when an imperfect scorer can improve the generator, showing that scorer-mediated refinement is reliable when scorer-selected targets are enriched under the true evaluator and updates remain conservative. On NAVSIM, CLOVER achieves 94.5 PDMS and 90.4 EPDMS, establishing a new state of the art. On the more challenging NavHard split, it obtains 48.3 EPDMS, matching the strongest reported result. On supplementary nuScenes open-loop evaluation, CLOVER achieves the lowest L2 error and collision rate among compared methods. Code data will be released at https://github.com/WilliamXuanYu/CLOVER.
tldr: CLOVER addresses the training-evaluation mismatch in end-to-end autonomous driving planners by proposing a closed-loop value estimation and ranking framework with a generator-scorer architecture, achieving state-of-the-art performance on planning metrics.
tldr_zh: CLOVER 提出了一种用于端到端自动驾驶规划的闭环价值估计与排序框架，通过生成器-评分器架构解决训练与评估不匹配问题，在规划指标上达到了最先进的性能。
summary_zh: 端到端自动驾驶规划器通常通过模仿单个记录轨迹进行训练，但评估时却采用基于规则的规划指标来衡量安全性、可行性、行驶进度和舒适性。这导致训练与评估之间存在不匹配问题：接近记录路径的轨迹可能违反规划规则，而偏离示范轨迹的备选方案反而可能保持有效且获得高分。这种不匹配对候选选择型规划器尤为不利，因为其性能取决于候选集的覆盖范围和评分器的排序质量。为此，我们提出CLOVER——一种用于端到端自动驾驶规划的闭环价值估计与排序框架。CLOVER采用轻量化的生成器-评分器架构：生成器产生多样化的候选轨迹，评分器在推理时预测规划指标子分数并对候选轨迹进行排序。为突破单轨迹模仿的局限，CLOVER构建了经评估器筛选的伪专家轨迹，并通过集合级覆盖监督来训练生成器。随后，系统执行保守的闭环自蒸馏：评分器通过生成提案上的真实评估器子分数进行拟合，而生成器则朝着教师选定的top-$k$目标与向量帕累托目标进行稳定性正则化精炼。我们分析了不完美评分器提升生成器的条件，证明当评分器选定的目标在真实评估器下得到强化且更新保持保守时，评分器介导的精炼过程具有可靠性。在NAVSIM数据集上，CLOVER实现了94.5 PDMS和90.4 EPDMS，创造了新的性能记录。在更具挑战性的NavHard子集上，其获得48.3 EPDMS，与已报道的最佳结果持平。在nuScenes开环补充评估中，CLOVER在对比方法中取得了最低的L2误差和碰撞率。代码与数据将在https://github.com/WilliamXuanYu/CLOVER发布。

title: Evo-Depth: A Lightweight Depth-Enhanced Vision-Language-Action Model
summary: Vision-Language-Action models have emerged as a promising paradigm for robotic manipulation by unifying perception, language grounding, and action generation. However, they often struggle in scenarios requiring precise spatial understanding, as current VLA models primarily rely on 2D visual representations that lack depth information and detailed spatial relationships. While recent approaches incorporate explicit 3D inputs such as depth maps or point clouds to address this issue, they often increase system complexity, require additional sensors, and remain vulnerable to sensing noise and reconstruction errors. Another line of work explores implicit 3D-aware spatial modeling directly from RGB observations without extra sensors, but it often relies on large geometry foundation models, resulting in higher training and deployment costs. To address these challenges, we propose Evo-Depth, a lightweight depth-enhanced VLA framework that enhances spatially grounded manipulation without relying on additional sensing hardware or compromising deployment efficiency. Evo-Depth employs a lightweight Implicit Depth Encoding Module to extract compact depth features from multi-view RGB images. These features are incorporated into vision-language representations through a Spatial Enhancement Module via depth-aware modulation, enabling efficient spatial-semantic enhancement. A Progressive Alignment Training strategy is further introduced to align the resulting depth-enhanced representations with downstream action learning. With only 0.9B parameters, Evo-Depth achieves superior performance across four simulation benchmarks. In real-world experiments, Evo-Depth attains the highest average success rate while also exhibiting the smallest model size, lowest GPU memory usage, and highest inference frequency among compared methods.
tldr: Evo-Depth is a lightweight depth-enhanced Vision-Language-Action model for robotic manipulation that extracts implicit depth features from multi-view RGB and uses depth-aware modulation for spatial-semantic enhancement, achieving strong performance with high efficiency.
tldr_zh: Evo-Depth 是一种轻量级深度增强视觉-语言-动作模型，用于机器人操作。它从多视角RGB图像中提取隐式深度特征，并通过深度感知调制进行空间语义增强，以高效率实现了强大的性能。
summary_zh: 视觉-语言-动作模型通过统一感知、语言理解与动作生成，已成为机器人操作领域前景广阔的范式。然而，在当前主要依赖二维视觉表征的模型架构中，由于缺乏深度信息与精细空间关系，其在需要精确空间理解的场景中往往表现不佳。虽然近期研究通过引入深度图或点云等显式三维输入以应对此问题，但这类方法通常增加了系统复杂性，需额外传感器支持，且易受感知噪声与重建误差影响。另一研究方向尝试直接从RGB观测中实现隐式三维空间建模而无需额外传感器，但常依赖大型几何基础模型，导致训练与部署成本较高。为解决这些挑战，我们提出Evo-Depth——一种轻量化的深度增强视觉-语言-动作框架，该框架在不依赖额外传感硬件或牺牲部署效率的前提下，显著提升了空间定位操作能力。Evo-Depth采用轻量化隐式深度编码模块，从多视角RGB图像中提取紧凑的深度特征；通过空间增强模块的深度感知调制机制，将这些特征融入视觉-语言表征，实现高效的空间语义增强。进一步引入渐进式对齐训练策略，将生成的深度增强表征与下游动作学习相校准。仅需9亿参数的Evo-Depth在四个仿真基准测试中均取得卓越性能；在真实世界实验中，其在所有对比方法中不仅达到最高平均成功率，同时保持最小模型体积、最低GPU内存消耗与最高推理频率。

title: Learning Direct Control Policies with Flow Matching for Autonomous Driving
summary: We present a flow-matching planner for autonomous driving that directly outputs actionable control trajectories defined by acceleration and curvature profiles. The model is conditioned on a bird's-eye-view (BEV) raster of the surrounding scene and generates control sequences in a small number of Ordinary Differential Equations (ODE) integration steps, enabling low-latency inference suitable for real-time closed-loop re-planning. We train exclusively on urban scenarios (real urban city streets, intersections and roundabouts of the city of Parma, Italy) collected from a 2D traffic simulator with reactive agents, and evaluate in closed-loop on both in-distribution and markedly out-of-distribution environments, including multi-lane highways and unseen urban scenarios. Our results show that the model generalizes reliably to these unseen conditions, maintaining stable closed-loop control and successfully completing scenarios that differ substantially from the training distribution. We attribute this to the BEV representation, which provides a geometry-centric view of the scene that is inherently less sensitive to distributional shifts, and to the flow-matching formulation, which learns a smooth vector field that degrades gracefully under distribution shift. We provide video demonstrations of closed-loop behavior at https://marcelloceresini.github.io/DirectControlFlowMatching.
tldr: This paper proposes a flow-matching planner for autonomous driving that directly outputs control trajectories from BEV rasters, enabling low-latency, real-time closed-loop control with demonstrated generalization to unseen scenarios.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种用于自动驾驶的流匹配规划器，它能够从BEV栅格直接输出控制轨迹，实现低延迟、实时的闭环控制，并在未见过的场景中展现出良好的泛化能力。
summary_zh: 本文提出了一种用于自动驾驶的流匹配规划器，该规划器直接输出由加速度和曲率配置文件定义的可执行控制轨迹。该模型以周围场景的鸟瞰图（BEV）栅格为条件，通过少量常微分方程（ODE）积分步骤生成控制序列，从而实现低延迟推理，适用于实时闭环重新规划。我们仅使用从二维交通模拟器（含反应性智能体）收集的意大利帕尔马市真实城市街道、交叉口和环岛等城市场景进行训练，并在分布内和明显分布外的环境中进行闭环评估，包括多车道高速公路和未见过的城市场景。结果表明，该模型能够可靠地推广到这些未见过的条件，保持稳定的闭环控制，并成功完成与训练分布差异显著的场景。我们认为这归功于BEV表示提供的以几何为中心的视角，该视角本质上对分布变化较不敏感，以及流匹配公式学习到的平滑向量场，在分布变化下能够优雅地退化。我们通过https://marcelloceresini.github.io/DirectControlFlowMatching提供了闭环行为的视频演示。

title: IntentVLA: Short-Horizon Intent Modeling for Aliased Robot Manipulation
summary: Robot imitation data are often multimodal: similar visual-language observations may be followed by different action chunks because human demonstrators act with different short-horizon intents, task phases, or recent context. Existing frame-conditioned VLA policies infer each chunk from the current observation and instruction alone, so under partial observability they may resample different intents across adjacent replanning steps, leading to inter-chunk conflict and unstable execution. We introduce IntentVLA, a history-conditioned VLA framework that encodes recent visual observations into a compact short-horizon intent representation and uses it to condition chunk generation. We further introduce AliasBench, a 12-task ambiguity-aware benchmark on RoboTwin2 with matched training data and evaluation environments that isolate short-horizon observation aliasing. Across AliasBench, SimplerEnv, LIBERO, and RoboCasa, IntentVLA improves rollout stability and outperforms strong VLA baselines
tldr: IntentVLA is a history-conditioned VLA framework that models short-horizon intent to resolve action ambiguity in multimodal imitation data, improving policy stability across manipulation benchmarks.
tldr_zh: IntentVLA 是一个历史条件化的 VLA 框架，通过建模短期意图来解决多模态模仿数据中的动作歧义，提升了策略在多个操作基准上的稳定性。
summary_zh: 机器人模仿数据通常具有多模态特性：相似的视觉语言观测可能对应不同的动作片段，这是由于人类演示者在执行动作时具有不同的短期意图、任务阶段或近期环境背景。现有的基于帧条件的视觉语言动作策略仅从当前观测和指令中推断每个动作片段，因此在部分可观测性条件下，可能在不同重规划步骤间重新采样出相互冲突的意图，导致片段间动作不协调和执行不稳定。我们提出了IntentVLA——一种历史条件约束的视觉语言动作框架，该框架将近期视觉观测编码为紧凑的短期意图表征，并以此作为生成动作片段的条件。此外，我们开发了AliasBench——在RoboTwin2平台上构建的包含12项任务的模糊感知基准测试集，其中匹配的训练数据与评估环境专门用于隔离短期观测的歧义性影响。在AliasBench、SimplerEnv、LIBERO和RoboCasa等测试平台上，IntentVLA显著提升了任务执行的稳定性，并在性能表现上超越了现有的先进视觉语言动作基线模型。

title: DSSP: Diffusion State Space Policy with Full-History Encoding
summary: Diffusion-based imitation learning has shown strong promise for robot manipulation. However, most existing policies condition only on the current observation or a short window of recent observations, limiting their ability to resolve history-dependent ambiguities in long-horizon tasks. To address this, we introduce DSSP, a history-conditioned Diffusion State Space Policy that enables efficient, full-history conditioning for robot manipulation. Leveraging the continuous sequence modeling properties of State Space Models (SSMs), our history encoder effectively compresses the entire observation stream into a compact context representation. To ensure this context preserves critical information regarding future state evolution, the encoder is optimized with a dynamics-aware auxiliary training objective. This high-level context representation is then seamlessly fused with recent state observations to form a hierarchical conditioning mechanism for action generation. Furthermore, to maintain architectural consistency and minimize GPU memory overhead, we also instantiate the diffusion backbone itself using an SSM. Extensive experiments across simulation benchmarks and real-world manipulation tasks show that DSSP achieves state-of-the-art performance with a significantly smaller model size, demonstrating superior efficiency of the hierarchical conditioning in capturing crucial information as the history length increases.
tldr: Introduces DSSP, a history-conditioned diffusion policy using State Space Models for full-history encoding and hierarchical conditioning, improving long-horizon robot manipulation performance.
tldr_zh: 提出DSSP，一种基于扩散的状态空间策略，利用状态空间模型进行全历史编码和分层条件控制，以提高长时域机器人操作的性能。
summary_zh: 基于扩散的模仿学习在机器人操作领域展现出巨大潜力。然而，现有策略大多仅以当前观测或近期观测窗口为条件，限制了其在长时序任务中处理历史依赖模糊性的能力。为此，我们提出DSSP——一种历史条件扩散状态空间策略，能够为机器人操作实现高效的全历史条件建模。通过利用状态空间模型连续序列建模的特性，我们的历史编码器能够将整个观测流有效压缩为紧凑的上下文表示。为确保该上下文保留未来状态演变的关键信息，编码器采用动态感知辅助训练目标进行优化。这种高层级上下文表示随后与近期状态观测无缝融合，形成动作生成的分层条件机制。此外，为保持架构一致性并最小化GPU内存开销，我们同样采用状态空间模型构建扩散主干网络。在仿真基准测试和真实世界操作任务中的大量实验表明，DSSP以更小的模型规模实现了最先进的性能，验证了分层条件机制在历史长度增加时捕获关键信息的卓越效率。

title: Before the Body Moves: Learning Anticipatory Joint Intent for Language-Conditioned Humanoid Control
summary: Natural language is an intuitive interface for humanoid robots, yet streaming whole-body control requires control representations that are executable now and anticipatory of future physical transitions. Existing language-conditioned humanoid systems typically generate kinematic references that a low-level tracker must repair reactively, or use latent/action policies whose outputs do not explicitly encode upcoming contact changes, support transfers, and balance preparation. We propose \textbf{DAJI} (\emph{Dynamics-Aligned Joint Intent}), a hierarchical framework that learns an anticipatory joint-intent interface between language generation and closed-loop control. DAJI-Act distills a future-aware teacher into a deployable diffusion action policy through student-driven rollouts, while DAJI-Flow autoregressively generates future intent chunks from language and intent history. Experiments show that DAJI achieves strong results in anticipatory latent learning, single-instruction generation, and streaming instruction following, reaching 94.42\% rollout success on HumanML3D-style generation and 0.152 subsequence FID on BABEL.
tldr: This paper proposes DAJI, a hierarchical framework for language-conditioned humanoid control that learns an anticipatory joint-intent interface to improve streaming whole-body control and explicitly encode future physical transitions.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了DAJI，一种用于语言条件化人形机器人控制的分层框架，它学习一个前瞻性的联合意图接口，以改进流式全身控制并显式编码未来的物理状态转换。
summary_zh: 摘要：自然语言是人形机器人的直观交互界面，然而流式全身控制需要能够即时执行且能预判未来物理状态转换的控制表征。现有基于语言条件的人形机器人系统通常生成运动学参考轨迹，需依赖底层跟踪器进行被动修复，或使用潜在/动作策略，其输出无法显式编码即将发生的接触变化、支撑转移与平衡准备动作。本文提出**DAJI**（动态对齐关节意图）——一种分层式框架，通过语言生成与闭环控制之间学习具备前瞻性的关节意图接口。DAJI-Act通过学生主导的推演，将具备未来感知能力的教师模型蒸馏为可部署的扩散动作策略；DAJI-Flow则依据语言指令与意图历史自回归生成未来意图片段。实验表明，DAJI在前瞻性潜在学习、单指令生成和流式指令跟随方面表现优异，在HumanML3D风格生成任务中达到94.42%的推演成功率，在BABEL数据集上获得0.152的子序列FID分数。

title: Systematic Discovery of Semantic Attacks in Online Map Construction through Conditional Diffusion
summary: Autonomous vehicles depend on online HD map construction to perceive lane boundaries, dividers, and pedestrian crossings -- safety-critical road elements that directly govern motion planning. While existing pixel perturbation attacks can disrupt the mapping, they can be neutralized by standard adversarial defenses. We present MIRAGE, a framework for systematic discovery of semantic attacks that bypass adversarial defenses and degrade mapping predictions by finding plausible environmental variation (e.g. shadows, wet roads). MIRAGE exploits the latent manifold of real-world data learned by diffusion models, and searches for semantically mutated scenes neighboring the ground truth with the same road topology yet mislead the mapping predictions. We evaluate MIRAGE on nuScenes and demonstrate two attacks: (1) boundary removal, suppressing 57.7% of detections and corrupting 96% of planned trajectories; and (2) boundary injection, the only method that successfully injects fictitious boundaries, while pixel PGD and AdvPatch fail entirely. Both attacks remain potent under various adversarial defenses. We use two independent VLM judges to quantify realism, where MIRAGE passes as realistic 80--84% of the time (vs. 97--99% for clean nuScenes), while AdvPatch only 0--9%. Our findings expose a categorical gap in current adversarial defenses: semantic-level perturbations that manifest as legitimate environmental variation are substantially harder to mitigate than pixel-level perturbations.
tldr: Proposes MIRAGE, a framework for semantic attacks on online HD map construction for autonomous vehicles by generating plausible environmental variations, bypassing adversarial defenses and degrading mapping predictions.
tldr_zh: 提出了MIRAGE框架，通过生成真实的环境变化，对自动驾驶车辆的在线高精地图构建进行语义攻击，绕过对抗防御并显著降低地图预测性能。
summary_zh: 自动驾驶车辆依赖在线高清地图构建来感知车道边界、隔离带和人行横道等直接影响运动规划的安全关键道路要素。尽管现有像素扰动攻击能够干扰地图构建，但它们可被标准对抗防御机制所中和。本文提出MIRAGE框架，通过寻找合理的环境变化（如阴影、潮湿路面），系统性地发现能绕过对抗防御并降低地图预测精度的语义攻击。MIRAGE利用扩散模型学习到的真实数据潜在流形，在保持道路拓扑结构不变的前提下，搜索与真实场景相邻且能误导地图预测的语义突变场景。我们在nuScenes数据集上评估MIRAGE，展示了两类攻击：（1）边界消除攻击，可抑制57.7%的检测结果并干扰96%的规划轨迹；（2）边界注入攻击，这是唯一成功注入虚构边界的方法，而像素PGD和AdvPatch攻击完全失效。两类攻击在多种对抗防御下均保持有效。我们采用两个独立的视觉语言模型作为评估器量化真实度，MIRAGE生成场景被判定为真实的比例达80-84%（清洁nuScenes数据为97-99%），而AdvPatch仅0-9%。研究结果揭示了当前对抗防御机制存在根本性缺陷：表现为合法环境变化的语义级扰动比像素级扰动更难被有效缓解。

title: Motion Planning for Autonomous Vehicles using Optimization over Graphs of Convex Sets
summary: Motion planning for autonomous vehicles requires generating collision-free and dynamically feasible trajectories in complex environments under real-time constraints. While nonlinear optimal control formulations provide high-fidelity solutions, they are computationally demanding and sensitive to initialization, whereas geometric planning methods scale well but often decouple path selection from trajectory optimization. This paper studies the extent to which optimization over Graphs of Convex Sets (GCS) can approximate solutions of nonlinear optimal control problems in the context of autonomous driving. The free space is represented as a finite union of convex regions organized as a directed graph, allowing nonconvex geometry to be handled through discrete connectivity decisions while maintaining convex trajectory constraints within each region. Vehicle motion is parameterized using Bezier curves for the spatial path and a polynomial time-scaling function for temporal evolution. Under small-slip and linear tire assumptions, a simplified dynamic bicycle model enables approximate enforcement of dynamic feasibility through convex constraints on trajectory derivatives. The approach is evaluated in CommonRoad scenarios involving static obstacle avoidance and lane-changing maneuvers, and is compared against a nonlinear discrete-time optimal control formulation. The results indicate that the GCS-based method generates collision-free and dynamically consistent trajectories that closely match those obtained from the nonlinear program, while exhibiting improved computational efficiency and reduced sensitivity to initialization. These findings suggest that GCS provides a structured approximation of nonlinear motion planning problems, capturing dominant geometric and dynamic effects while preserving convexity in the continuous relaxation.
tldr: This paper proposes a motion planning method for autonomous vehicles using optimization over Graphs of Convex Sets (GCS), which approximates nonlinear optimal control solutions to generate collision-free, dynamically feasible trajectories more efficiently.
tldr_zh: 本文提出一种基于凸集图优化的运动规划方法，用于自动驾驶车辆，通过近似非线性最优控制解来更高效地生成无碰撞、动态可行的轨迹。
summary_zh: 自动驾驶车辆的运动规划需要在实时约束下，为复杂环境生成无碰撞且动态可行的轨迹。尽管非线性最优控制方法能提供高精度解，但其计算成本高且对初始条件敏感；而几何规划方法虽具有良好的扩展性，却常将路径选择与轨迹优化过程分离。本文研究了在自动驾驶场景中，基于凸集图（GCS）的优化方法在多大程度上能逼近非线性最优控制问题的解。该方法将自由空间表示为若干凸区域的有向图并集，通过离散连接决策处理非凸几何问题，同时在每个区域内保持轨迹约束的凸性。车辆运动采用贝塞尔曲线描述空间路径，并利用多项式时间缩放函数表达时间演化过程。在小侧滑与线性轮胎假设下，采用简化的动态自行车模型，通过轨迹导数的凸约束近似实现动态可行性。在涉及静态障碍物避让与变道操作的CommonRoad场景中，本文方法与非线性离散时间最优控制方法进行了对比评估。结果表明，基于GCS的方法能生成无碰撞且动态一致的轨迹，其效果与非线性规划解高度吻合，同时展现出更优的计算效率及更低的初始条件敏感性。这些发现表明，GCS为非线性运动规划问题提供了结构化近似方案，在保持连续松弛凸性的同时，能够捕捉主导的几何与动力学特性。

title: When Robots Do the Chores: A Benchmark and Agent for Long-Horizon Household Task Execution
summary: Long-horizon household tasks demand robust high-level planning and sustained reasoning capabilities, which are largely overlooked by existing embodied AI benchmarks that emphasize short-horizon navigation or manipulation and rely on fixed task categories. We introduce LongAct, a benchmark designed to evaluate planning-level autonomy in long-horizon household tasks specified through free-form instructions. By abstracting away embodiment-specific low-level control, LongAct isolates high-level cognitive capabilities such as instruction understanding, dependency management, memory maintenance, and adaptive planning. We further propose HoloMind, a VLM-driven agent with a DAG-based long-horizon hierarchical planner, a Multimodal Spatial Memory for persistent world modeling, an Episodic Memory for experience reuse, and a global Critic for reflective supervision. Experiments with GPT-5 and Qwen3-VL models show that HoloMind substantially improves long-horizon performance while reducing reliance on model scale. Even top models achieve only 59% goal completion and 16% full-task success, underscoring the difficulty of LongAct and the need for stronger long-horizon planning in embodied agents.
tldr: Presents LongAct, a benchmark for long-horizon household task planning that abstracts away low-level control, and HoloMind, a VLM-driven agent with hierarchical planning and memory modules.
tldr_zh: 提出了用于长程家务任务规划的LongAct基准（抽象了低级控制），以及基于VLM的HoloMind智能体，具备层次规划器与记忆模块。
summary_zh:
摘要：  
长时程家庭任务要求具备稳健的高层规划与持续推理能力，而现有具身智能基准大多关注短时程导航或操作任务，依赖固定任务类别，忽视了这些能力。我们提出LongAct基准，旨在通过自由形式指令评估长时程家庭任务中的规划级自主性。该基准通过抽象化与具体实现相关的底层控制，将指令理解、依赖关系管理、记忆保持和自适应规划等高层认知能力独立评估。我们进一步提出HoloMind智能体：该智能体由视觉语言模型驱动，包含基于有向无环图的长时程分层规划器、用于持续世界建模的多模态空间记忆、用于经验复现的情景记忆，以及用于反思性监督的全局评价器。基于GPT-5和Qwen3-VL模型的实验表明，HoloMind显著提升了长时程任务表现，同时降低了对模型规模的依赖。即使顶级模型在LongAct上也仅达到59%的目标完成率和16%的全任务成功率，这凸显了该基准的难度以及具身智能体对更强长时程规划能力的需求。

title: EponaV2: Driving World Model with Comprehensive Future Reasoning
summary: Data scaling plays a pivotal role in the pursuit of general intelligence. However, the prevailing perception-planning paradigm in autonomous driving relies heavily on expensive manual annotations to supervise trajectory planning, which severely limits its scalability. Conversely, although existing perception-free driving world models achieve impressive driving performance, their real-world reasoning ability for planning is solely built on next frame image forecasting. Due to the lack of enough supervision, these models often struggle with comprehensive scene understanding, resulting in unsatisfactory trajectory planning. In this paper, we propose EponaV2, a novel paradigm of driving world models, which achieves high-quality planning with comprehensive future reasoning. Inspired by how human drivers anticipate 3D geometry and semantics, we train our model to forecast more comprehensive future representations, which can be additionally decoded to future geometry and semantic maps. Extracting the 3D and semantic modalities enables our model to deeply understand the surrounding environment, and the future prediction task significantly enhances the real-world reasoning capabilities of EponaV2, ultimately leading to improved trajectory planning. Moreover, inspired by the training recipe of Large Language Models (LLMs), we introduce a flow matching group relative policy optimization mechanism to further improve planning accuracy. The state-of-the-art (SOTA) performances of EponaV2 among perception-free models on three NAVSIM benchmarks (+1.3PDMS, +5.5EPDMS) demonstrate the effectiveness of our methods.
tldr: EponaV2 is a driving world model that improves trajectory planning by forecasting comprehensive future 3D geometry and semantic representations, achieving state-of-the-art perception-free driving results.
tldr_zh: EponaV2是一种驾驶世界模型，通过预测全面的未来3D几何和语义表示来提升轨迹规划能力，在感知无关的驾驶模型中实现了最先进的性能。
summary_zh: 数据规模化在通用智能的追求中扮演着关键角色。然而，当前自动驾驶领域主流的感知-规划范式严重依赖昂贵的人工标注来监督轨迹规划，这极大地限制了其可扩展性。相反，尽管现有的无感知驾驶世界模型已展现出优异的驾驶性能，但其用于规划的现实世界推理能力仅基于下一帧图像预测。由于缺乏足够的监督，这些模型往往难以实现全面的场景理解，导致轨迹规划效果不尽人意。本文提出EponaV2——一种新型驾驶世界模型范式，通过全面未来推理实现高质量规划。受人类驾驶员预判三维几何与语义的启发，我们训练模型预测更全面的未来表征，这些表征可额外解码为未来几何与语义地图。提取三维与语义模态使模型能深度理解周围环境，而未来预测任务显著增强了EponaV2的现实世界推理能力，最终实现更优的轨迹规划。此外，借鉴大语言模型的训练方法，我们引入流匹配群组相对策略优化机制以进一步提升规划精度。EponaV2在三个NAVSIM基准测试中（+1.3PDMS, +5.5EPDMS）取得无感知模型领域的先进性能，充分证明了本方法的有效性。

title: CreFlow: Corrective Reflow for Sparse-Reward Embodied Video Diffusion RL
summary: Video generation models trained on heterogeneous data with likelihood-surrogate objectives can produce visually plausible rollouts that violate physical constraints in embodied manipulation. Although reinforcement-learning post-training offers a natural route to adapting VGMs, existing video-RL rewards often reduce each rollout to a low-level visual metric, whereas manipulation video evaluation requires logic-based verification of whether the rollout satisfies a compositional task specification. To fill this gap, we introduce a compositional constraint-based reward model for post-training embodied video generation models, which automatically formulates task requirements as a composition of Linear Temporal Logic constraints, providing faithful rewards and localized error information in generated videos. To achieve effective improvement in high-dimensional video generation using these reward signals, we further propose CreFlow, a novel online RL framework with two key designs: i) a credit-aware NFT loss that confines the RL update to reward-relevant regions, preventing perturbations to unrelated regions during post-training; and ii) a corrective reflow loss that leverages within-group positive samples as an explicit estimate of the correction direction, stabilizing and accelerating training. Experiments show that CreFlow yields reward judgments better aligned with human and simulator success labels than existing methods and improves downstream execution success by 23.8 percentage points across eight bimanual manipulation tasks.
tldr: This paper introduces CreFlow, a corrective reflow framework for improving embodied video generation models through reinforcement learning with a compositional constraint-based reward model. It focuses on bimanual manipulation tasks, enhancing reward alignment with human judgment and increasing execution success rates.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了CreFlow，一种用于改善具身视频生成模型的纠正回流框架，通过基于组合约束的奖励模型的强化学习，专注于双手操作任务，提高了奖励与人类判断的对齐度及执行成功率。
summary_zh: 基于似然替代目标在异构数据上训练的视频生成模型，尽管能够生成视觉上合理的推演序列，却可能违反具身操控中的物理约束。虽然强化学习后训练为调整视频生成模型提供了一条自然路径，但现有的视频强化学习奖励通常将每个推演序列简化为低层次视觉指标，而操控视频评估则需要基于逻辑来验证推演是否满足组合式任务规范。为填补这一空白，我们提出了一种基于组合约束的奖励模型，用于后训练具身视频生成模型。该模型能自动将任务需求形式化为线性时序逻辑约束的组合，从而为生成的视频提供可靠的奖励信号和局部化错误信息。为了利用这些奖励信号有效改进高维视频生成，我们进一步提出CreFlow——一种新颖的在线强化学习框架，其包含两项关键设计：其一，信用感知的NFT损失函数，将强化学习更新限制在奖励相关区域，防止后训练过程中对无关区域产生干扰；其二，校正重流损失函数，利用组内正样本作为校正方向的显式估计，从而稳定并加速训练过程。实验表明，与现有方法相比，CreFlow提供的奖励判断更符合人类评价和模拟器成功标签，并在八项双手操控任务中将下游执行成功率平均提升了23.8个百分点。

title: CoCo-InEKF: State Estimation with Learned Contact Covariances in Dynamic, Contact-Rich Scenarios
summary: Robust state estimation for highly dynamic motion of legged robots remains challenging, especially in dynamic, contact-rich scenarios. Traditional approaches often rely on binary contact states that fail to capture the nuances of partial contact or directional slippage. This paper presents CoCo-InEKF, a differentiable invariant extended Kalman filter that utilizes continuous contact velocity covariances instead of binary contact states. These learned covariances allow the method to dynamically modulate contact confidence, accounting for more nuanced conditions ranging from firm contact to directional slippage or no contact. To predict these covariances for a set of predefined contact candidate points, we employ a lightweight neural network trained end-to-end using a state-error loss. This approach eliminates the need for heuristic ground-truth contact labels. In addition, we propose an automated contact candidate selection procedure and demonstrate that our method is insensitive to their exact placement. Experiments on a bipedal robot demonstrate a superior accuracy-efficiency tradeoff for linear velocity estimation, as well as improved filter consistency compared to baseline methods. This enables the robust execution of challenging motions, including dancing and complex ground interactions -- both in simulation and in the real world.
tldr: The paper introduces CoCo-InEKF, a differentiable invariant extended Kalman filter that learns continuous contact velocity covariances for state estimation in legged robots, enabling robust motion in dynamic, contact-rich scenarios.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了CoCo-InEKF，一种可微不变扩展卡尔曼滤波器，通过学习连续接触速度协方差用于双足机器人的状态估计，从而在动态、接触丰富的场景中实现鲁棒运动。
summary_zh: 针对腿式机器人高动态运动的状态估计仍面临挑战，尤其在动态且频繁接触的场景中。传统方法通常依赖二元接触状态，难以捕捉部分接触或方向性滑移的细微差异。本文提出CoCo-InEKF——一种可微不变扩展卡尔曼滤波器，该方法采用连续接触速度协方差替代二元接触状态。通过学习得到的协方差，系统能够动态调整接触置信度，从而适应从稳固接触、方向性滑移到无接触等复杂状况。为预测预定义接触候选点的协方差，我们采用轻量级神经网络进行端到端训练，并使用状态误差损失函数，该方法无需依赖启发式地面真实接触标签。此外，我们提出自动接触候选点选择机制，并证明该方法对接触点具体布局不敏感。在双足机器人上的实验表明，该方法在线速度估计的精度与效率平衡方面优于基线方法，同时提升了滤波器一致性。这使机器人能够在仿真和现实环境中稳定执行舞蹈、复杂地面交互等高难度动作。

title: Let Robots Feel Your Touch: Visuo-Tactile Cortical Alignment for Embodied Mirror Resonance
summary: Observing touch on another's body can elicit corresponding tactile sensations in the observer, a phenomenon termed mirror touch that supports empathy and social perception. This visuo-tactile resonance is thought to rely on structural correspondence between visual and somatosensory cortices, yet robotic systems lack computational frameworks that instantiate this principle. Here we demonstrate that cortical correspondence can be operationalized to endow robots with mirror touch. We introduce Mirror Touch Net, which imposes semantic, distributional and geometric alignment between visual and tactile representations through multi-level constraints, enabling prediction of millimetre-scale tactile signals across 1,140 taxels on a robotic hand from RGB images. Manifold analysis reveals that these constraints reshape visual representations into geometry consistent with the tactile manifold, reducing the complexity of cross-modal mapping. Extending this alignment framework to cross-domain observations of human hands enables tactile prediction and reflexive responses to observed human touch. Our results link a neural principle of visuo-tactile resonance to robotic perception, providing an explainable route towards anticipatory touch and empathic human-robot interaction. Code is available at https://github.com/fun0515/Mirror-Touch-Net.
tldr: The paper introduces Mirror Touch Net, a framework that imposes multi-level constraints to align visual and tactile representations, enabling robots to predict tactile signals from RGB images and exhibit reflexive responses to observed human touch.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了Mirror Touch Net框架，通过施加多层级约束对齐视觉和触觉表征，使机器人能够从RGB图像预测触觉信号，并对观察到的人类触摸产生反射性响应。
summary_zh: 观察到他人身体被触碰时，观察者自身会产生相应的触觉感受，这种现象称为镜像触觉，它支撑着共情与社会感知。这种视觉-触觉共振被认为依赖于视觉与躯体感觉皮层之间的结构对应关系，然而机器人系统尚缺乏体现这一原理的计算框架。本研究证明，皮层对应关系可被转化为计算模型，使机器人具备镜像触觉能力。我们提出镜像触觉网络，通过多层级约束实现视觉与触觉表征在语义、分布和几何层面的对齐，使得系统能够根据RGB图像预测机器人手部1,140个触觉单元上毫米级精度的触觉信号。流形分析表明，这些约束将视觉表征重构为与触觉流形几何一致的形式，从而降低了跨模态映射的复杂度。将该对齐框架扩展至人类手部的跨域观察后，系统可实现触觉预测并对观察到的人类触碰产生反射性响应。我们的研究将视觉-触觉共振的神经原理与机器人感知相连接，为预见性触觉与共情式人机交互提供了可解释的实现路径。代码开源地址：https://github.com/fun0515/Mirror-Touch-Net。

title: Energy-Efficient Quadruped Locomotion with Compliant Feet
summary: Quadruped robots are often designed with rigid feet to simplify control and maintain stable contact during locomotion. While this approach is straightforward, it limits the ability of the legs to absorb impact forces and reuse stored elastic energy, leading to higher energy expenditure during locomotion. To explore whether compliant feet can provide an advantage, we integrate foot compliance into a reinforcement learning (RL) locomotion controller and study its effect on walking efficiency. In simulation, we train eight policies corresponding to eight different spring stiffness values and then cross-evaluate their performance by measuring mechanical energy consumed per meter traveled. In experiments done on a developed quadruped, the energy consumption for the intermediate stiffness spring is lower by ~ 17% when compared to a very stiff or a very flexible spring incorporated in the feet, with similar trends appearing in the simulation results. These results indicate that selecting an appropriate foot compliance can improve locomotion efficiency without destabilizing the robot during motion.
tldr: This paper explores how integrating foot compliance via springs into a reinforcement learning locomotion controller for a quadruped robot can reduce energy consumption during walking by optimizing spring stiffness, showing a ~17% improvement in efficiency on a real robot.
tldr_zh: 本研究通过将足部柔顺性整合到四足机器人强化学习运动控制器中，探索优化弹簧刚度以减少行走能耗，在真实机器人上实现了约17%的能效提升。
summary_zh: 四足机器人通常采用刚性足部设计，以简化运动控制并保持运动过程中的接触稳定性。尽管这种方法简单直接，但限制了腿部吸收冲击力以及重复利用存储弹性势能的能力，导致运动时能耗更高。为探究柔性足部是否具有优势，我们将足部柔顺性融入强化学习运动控制器中，并研究其对行走效率的影响。在仿真环境中，我们训练了对应八种不同弹簧刚度值的控制策略，并通过测量每移动一米所消耗的机械能进行交叉性能评估。在已开发的四足机器人实验中发现，采用中等刚度弹簧的足部能耗相较于极高刚度或极柔性弹簧设计降低了约17%，仿真结果也呈现出相似的趋势。这些结果表明，选择合适的足部柔顺性可以在不破坏机器人运动稳定性的前提下提升运动效率。

title: WarmPrior: Straightening Flow-Matching Policies with Temporal Priors
summary: Generative policies based on diffusion and flow matching have become a dominant paradigm for visuomotor robotic control. We show that replacing the standard Gaussian source distribution with WarmPrior, a simple temporally grounded prior constructed from readily available recent action history, consistently improves success rates on robotic manipulation tasks. We trace this gain to markedly straighter probability paths, echoing the effect of optimal-transport couplings in Rectified Flow. Beyond standard behavior cloning, WarmPrior also reshapes the exploration distribution in prior-space reinforcement learning, improving both sample efficiency and final performance. Collectively, these results identify the source distribution as an important and underexplored design axis in generative robot control.
tldr: This paper introduces WarmPrior, a method that improves generative robot manipulation policies by using a temporally grounded action-history prior, which straightens probability paths and enhances success rates and sample efficiency.
tldr_zh: 本文提出WarmPrior方法，通过使用基于近期动作历史的时间先验来改进生成式机器人操作策略，拉直概率路径，提高了任务成功率和样本效率。
summary_zh: 摘要：基于扩散模型与流匹配的生成式策略已成为视觉运动机器人控制的主导范式。本文研究表明，通过采用WarmPrior这一基于近期动作历史构建的简单时序基础先验分布，替代标准高斯源分布，可持续提升机器人操作任务的成功率。我们将此改进归因于概率路径显著趋于平直，这与整流流中最优传输耦合的效应相呼应。除标准行为克隆外，WarmPrior还能重塑先验空间强化学习中的探索分布，从而提升样本效率与最终性能。这些成果共同揭示了源分布作为生成式机器人控制中一个重要且尚未充分探索的设计维度。

title: SANA-WM: Efficient Minute-Scale World Modeling with Hybrid Linear Diffusion Transformer
summary: We introduce SANA-WM, an efficient 2.6B-parameter open-source world model natively trained for one-minute generation, synthesizing high-fidelity, 720p, minute-scale videos with precise camera control. SANA-WM achieves visual quality comparable to large-scale industrial baselines such as LingBot-World and HY-WorldPlay, while significantly improving efficiency. Four core designs drive our architecture: (1) Hybrid Linear Attention combines frame-wise Gated DeltaNet (GDN) with softmax attention for memory-efficient long-context modeling. (2) Dual-Branch Camera Control ensures precise 6-DoF trajectory adherence. (3) Two-Stage Generation Pipeline applies a long-video refiner to stage-1 outputs, improving quality and consistency across sequences. (4) Robust Annotation Pipeline extracts accurate metric-scale 6-DoF camera poses from public videos to yield high-quality, spatiotemporally consistent action labels. Driven by these designs, SANA-WMdemonstrates remarkable efficiency across data, training compute, and inference hardware: it uses only $\sim$213K public video clips with metric-scale pose supervision, completes training in 15 days on 64 H100s, and generates each 60s clip on a single GPU; its distilled variant can be deployed on a single RTX 5090 with NVFP4 quantization to denoise a 60s 720p clip in 34s. On our one-minute world-model benchmark, SANA-WM demonstrates stronger action-following accuracy than prior open-source baselines and achieves comparable visual quality at $36\times$ higher throughput for scalable world modeling.
tldr: SANA-WM is an efficient 2.6B-parameter world model for generating high-fidelity, minute-scale 720p videos with precise camera control, featuring hybrid linear attention and a two-stage generation pipeline.
tldr_zh: SANA-WM是一种高效的26亿参数世界模型，用于生成具有精确相机控制的高保真、分钟级720p视频，采用了混合线性注意力与两阶段生成流程。
summary_zh: 我们推出SANA-WM，这是一个高效的开源世界模型，拥有26亿参数并原生支持一分钟视频生成，能够合成具有精确相机控制的高保真度720p分钟级视频。该模型在视觉质量上达到与LingBot-World、HY-WorldPlay等大规模工业基线相当的水平，同时显著提升了效率。我们的架构基于四项核心设计：(1) 混合线性注意力机制融合了帧间门控DeltaNet与softmax注意力，实现内存高效的长上下文建模；(2) 双分支相机控制系统确保对六自由度轨迹的精确跟随；(3) 两阶段生成流程通过长视频优化器处理初阶输出，提升序列整体质量与连贯性；(4) 鲁棒标注流程从公开视频中提取精确度量尺度的六自由度相机位姿，生成高质量且时空一致的动作标签。在这些设计驱动下，SANA-WM在数据使用、训练计算和推理硬件方面展现出卓越效率：仅需约21.3万个带有度量尺度位姿监督的公开视频片段，在64张H100显卡上15天完成训练，且单张GPU即可生成60秒视频片段；其蒸馏版本通过NVFP4量化部署在单张RTX 5090显卡上，可在34秒内完成60秒720p片段的去噪处理。在我们的一分钟世界模型基准测试中，SANA-WM展现出优于现有开源基准模型的动作跟随精度，并以提升36倍吞吐率的可扩展世界建模能力，实现了同等级别的视觉质量。

title: Real2Sim in HOI: Toward Physically Plausible HOI Reconstruction from Monocular Videos
summary: Recovering 4D human-object interaction (HOI) from monocular video is a key step toward scalable 3D content creation, embodied AI, and simulation-based learning. Recent methods can reconstruct temporally coherent human and object trajectories, but these trajectories often remain visual artifacts while failing to preserve stable contact, functional manipulation, or physical plausibility when used as reference motions for humanoid-object simulation. This reveals a fundamental interaction gap: HOI reconstruction should not stop at tracking a human and an object, but should recover the relation that makes their motion a coherent interaction. We introduce $\textbf{HA-HOI}$, a framework for reconstructing physically plausible 4D HOI animation from in-the-wild monocular videos. Instead of treating the human and object as independent entities in an ambiguous monocular 3D space, we propose a $\textit{human-first, object-follow}$ formulation. The human motion is recovered as the interaction anchor, and the object is reconstructed, aligned, and refined relative to the human action. The resulting kinematic trajectory is then projected into a physics-based humanoid-object simulation, where it acts as a teacher trajectory for stable physical rollout. Across benchmark and in-the-wild videos, $\textbf{HA-HOI}$ improves human-object alignment, contact consistency, temporal stability, and simulation readiness over prior monocular HOI reconstruction methods. By moving beyond visually plausible trajectory recovery toward physically grounded interaction animation, our work takes a step toward turning general monocular HOI videos into scalable demonstrations for humanoid-object behavior. Project page: https://knoxzhao.github.io/real2sim_in_HOI/
tldr: The paper introduces HA-HOI, a framework for reconstructing physically plausible 4D human-object interaction animations from monocular videos, which are then used as teacher trajectories for physics-based humanoid-object simulation to improve simulation readiness.
tldr_zh: 本文提出HA-HOI框架，从单目视频中重建物理合理的4D人-物交互动画，并将其作为教师轨迹用于基于物理的人形机器人-物体仿真，以提高仿真准备度。
summary_zh: 从单目视频中恢复4D人物-物体交互（HOI）是实现可扩展3D内容创作、具身人工智能以及基于仿真的学习的关键步骤。现有方法能够重建时间一致的人物与物体轨迹，但这些轨迹在作为仿人形物体运动的参考时，常存在视觉瑕疵，且难以保持稳定接触、功能性操作或物理合理性。这揭示了一个根本性的交互鸿沟：HOI重建不应止步于对人物和物体的追踪，而应恢复使其运动成为连贯交互的内在关系。我们提出$\textbf{HA-HOI}$框架，用于从真实场景单目视频中重建物理合理的4D HOI动画。区别于在模糊的单目3D空间中独立处理人物与物体，我们提出一种“人物主导、物体跟随”的建模方法：以人物动作为交互锚点恢复其运动，并以此为参照重建、对齐并优化物体运动。所得运动学轨迹随后被映射至基于物理的仿人形物体仿真系统中，作为稳定物理推演的教师轨迹。在基准视频和真实场景视频中，$\textbf{HA-HOI}$相比现有单目HOI重建方法，在人物-物体对齐度、接触一致性、时间稳定性以及仿真就绪度方面均有提升。通过超越视觉合理的轨迹恢复，迈向基于物理的交互动画生成，我们的工作朝着将通用单目HOI视频转化为可扩展的仿人形物体行为演示迈出了关键一步。项目页面：https://knoxzhao.github.io/real2sim_in_HOI/

title: Slot-MPC: Goal-Conditioned Model Predictive Control with Object-Centric Representations
summary: Predictive world models enable agents to model scene dynamics and reason about the consequences of their actions. Inspired by human perception, object-centric world models capture scene dynamics using object-level representations, which can be used for downstream applications such as action planning. However, most object-centric world models and reinforcement learning (RL) approaches learn reactive policies that are fixed at inference time, limiting generalization to novel situations. We propose Slot-MPC, an object-centric world modeling framework that enables planning through Model Predictive Control (MPC). Slot-MPC leverages vision encoders to learn slot-based representations, which encode individual objects in the scene, and uses these structured representations to learn an action-conditioned object-centric dynamics model. At inference time, the learned dynamics model enables action planning via MPC, allowing agents to adapt to previously unseen situations. Since the learned world model is differentiable, we can use gradient-based MPC to directly optimize actions, which is computationally more efficient than relying on gradient-free, sampling-based MPC methods. Experiments on simulated robotic manipulation tasks show that Slot-MPC improves both task performance and planning efficiency compared to non-object-centric world model baselines. In the considered offline setting with limited state-action coverage, we find that gradient-based MPC performs better than gradient-free, sampling-based MPC. Our results demonstrate that explicitly structured, object-centric representations provide a strong inductive bias for controllable and generalizable decision-making. Code and additional results are available at https://slot-mpc.github.io.
tldr: Slot-MPC is an object-centric world modeling framework that uses slot-based representations to learn a differentiable dynamics model for gradient-based Model Predictive Control, improving task performance and planning efficiency in simulated robotic manipulation tasks.
tldr_zh: Slot-MPC 是一种以目标为中心的世界建模框架，它利用基于槽位的表征来学习一个可微分的动力学模型，用于基于梯度的模型预测控制，在模拟机器人操作任务中提高了任务性能和规划效率。
summary_zh: 摘要：预测世界模型使智能体能够模拟场景动态并推理其行为后果。受人类感知启发，以物体为中心的世界模型利用物体级表征捕捉场景动态，可应用于动作规划等下游任务。然而，现有大多数以物体为中心的世界模型和强化学习方法所习得的反应式策略在推理时固定不变，限制了其对新情境的泛化能力。我们提出Slot-MPC——一种支持通过模型预测控制进行规划的对象中心化世界建模框架。该方法利用视觉编码器学习基于槽位的场景表征，对场景中的独立物体进行编码，并运用这些结构化表征训练动作条件下的对象中心化动态模型。在推理阶段，习得的动态模型通过模型预测控制实现动作规划，使智能体能适应未知情境。由于该世界模型具有可微特性，我们可采用基于梯度的模型预测控制直接优化动作，其计算效率优于依赖无梯度采样方法。在模拟机器人操作任务中的实验表明，相较于非对象中心化世界模型基线，Slot-MPC在任务性能和规划效率上均有提升。在状态-动作覆盖有限的离线设定下，基于梯度的模型预测控制表现优于无梯度采样方法。我们的研究结果表明，显式结构的对象中心化表征为可控且可泛化的决策提供了强归纳偏置。代码及补充结果详见 https://slot-mpc.github.io。

title: Chrono-Gymnasium: An Open-Source, Gymnasium-Compatible Distributed Simulation Framework
summary: High-fidelity physics simulation is essential for closing the sim-to-real gap in robotics and complex mechanical systems. However, the computational overhead of high-fidelity engines often limits their use in data-intensive tasks like Reinforcement Learning (RL) and global optimization. We introduce Chrono-Gymnasium, a distributed computing framework that scales the high-fidelity multi-body dynamics of Project Chrono across large-scale computing clusters. Built upon the Ray framework, Chrono-Gymnasium provides a standardized Gymnasium interface, enabling seamless integration with modern machine learning libraries while providing built-in synchronization and messaging primitives for distributed execution. We demonstrate the framework's capabilities through two distinct case studies: (1) the training of an RL agent for autonomous robotic navigation in complex terrains, and (2) the Bayesian Optimization of a planetary lander's design parameters to ensure landing stability. Our results show that Chrono-Gymnasium reduces wall-clock time for high-fidelity simulations without sacrificing physical accuracy, offering a scalable path for the design and control of complex robotic systems.
tldr: Chrono-Gymnasium is a distributed simulation framework built on Project Chrono and Ray, providing a Gymnasium-compatible interface for scalable high-fidelity physics simulations to accelerate RL training and design optimization for robotic systems.
tldr_zh: Chrono-Gymnasium是一个基于Project Chrono和Ray构建的分布式仿真框架，提供Gymnasium兼容接口，用于可扩展的高保真物理仿真，以加速机器人系统的强化学习训练和设计优化。
summary_zh: 高保真物理仿真对于缩小机器人及复杂机械系统的仿真与现实差距至关重要。然而，高保真仿真引擎的计算开销往往限制了其在强化学习与全局优化等数据密集型任务中的应用。本文提出Chrono-Gymnasium——一个基于分布式计算框架的解决方案，通过将Project Chrono高保真多体动力学仿真扩展至大规模计算集群。该框架基于Ray架构构建，提供标准化Gymnasium接口，既能与现代机器学习库无缝集成，又内置了分布式执行所需的同步与消息传递原语。我们通过两个案例验证了该框架的性能：（1）在复杂地形中训练自主机器人导航的强化学习智能体；（2）通过贝叶斯优化调整行星着陆器的设计参数以确保着陆稳定性。实验结果表明，Chrono-Gymnasium在不损失物理精度的前提下显著缩短了高保真仿真的实际运行时间，为复杂机器人系统的设计与控制提供了可扩展的实现路径。

title: Learning Cross-Coupled and Regime Dependent Dynamics for Aerial Manipulation
summary: Accurate dynamics models are critical for aerial manipulators operating under complex tasks such as payload transport. However, modeling these systems remains fundamentally challenging due to strong quadrotor-manipulator coupling, delayed aerodynamic interactions, and regime-dependent dynamics variations arising from payload changes and manipulator reconfiguration. These effects produce residual dynamics that are simultaneously cross-coupled, history-dependent, and nonstationary, causing both analytical models and purely offline learned models to degrade during deployment. To address these challenges, we propose a structured encoder-decoder framework for adaptive residual dynamics learning in aerial manipulators. The proposed nonlinear latent encoder captures cross-variable coupling and temporal dependencies from state-input histories, while a lightweight linear latent decoder enables online adaptation under regime-dependent nonstationary dynamics. The linear-in-parameter decoder structure permits closed-form Bayesian adaptation together with consistency-driven covariance inflation, enabling rapid and stable adaptation to both transient and slowly varying dynamics changes while remaining compatible with real-time model predictive control (MPC). Experimental results on a real aerial manipulation platform demonstrate improved residual prediction accuracy, faster adaptation under changing operating conditions, and enhanced MPC-based trajectory tracking performance. These results highlight the importance of jointly modeling coupled temporal dynamics and deployment-time nonstationarity for reliable aerial manipulation.
tldr: Proposes a structured encoder-decoder framework for adaptive residual dynamics learning in aerial manipulators, enabling rapid online adaptation to cross-coupled, history-dependent, and nonstationary dynamics for improved real-time MPC.
tldr_zh: 提出了一种用于空中机械臂自适应残差动力学学习的结构化编码器-解码器框架，可快速在线适应交叉耦合、历史依赖和非平稳动力学，以改进实时MPC。
summary_zh: 高精度动力学模型对于执行载荷运输等复杂任务的空中机械臂至关重要。然而，由于四旋翼与机械臂的强耦合效应、延迟的空气动力相互作用，以及载荷变化与机械臂构型调整引发的工况依赖型动态特性变化，此类系统的建模仍然面临根本性挑战。这些效应会产生同时具有交叉耦合性、历史依赖性和非平稳性的残余动力学，导致解析模型与纯离线学习模型在实际部署中出现性能退化。为解决这些问题，我们提出了一种结构化编码器-解码器框架，用于实现空中机械臂的自适应残余动力学学习。该非线性潜在编码器可从状态输入历史中捕获跨变量耦合关系与时间依赖性，而轻量级线性潜在解码器则支持在工况依赖型非平稳动力学下的在线自适应。这种参数线性化的解码器结构支持闭式贝叶斯自适应及一致性驱动的协方差膨胀机制，能够快速稳定地适应瞬态与缓变动力学变化，同时保持与实时模型预测控制（MPC）的兼容性。在真实空中操控平台上的实验结果表明，该方法提升了残余动力学预测精度，加快了变化工况下的自适应速度，并增强了基于MPC的轨迹跟踪性能。这些成果凸显了联合建模耦合时变动力学与部署阶段非平稳特性对于实现可靠空中操控的重要意义。

title: Exploring Bottlenecks in VLM-LLM Navigation: How 3D Scene Understanding Capability Impacts Zero-Shot VLN
summary: Zero-shot vision-and-language navigation (VLN) has gained significant attention due to its minimal data collection costs and inherent generalization. This paradigm is typically driven by the integration of pre-trained Vision-Language Models (VLMs) and Large Language Models (LLMs), where VLMs construct 3D scene graphs while LLMs handle high-level reasoning and decision-making. However, a critical bottleneck exists in this system: current 3D perception models prioritize pixel-level accuracy, directly conflicting with the strict computational limits and real-time efficiency demanded by embodied navigation. To address this gap, this paper quantifies the actual impact of 3D scene understanding capability on VLN performance. Based on typical VLM-LLM frameworks, we propose statistical success rate (SR) upper bounds for two core subsystems: 1) the slow LLM planner, which relies on topological mapping semantics, and 2) the fast reactive navigator, which utilizes spatial coordinates and bounding boxes to execute LLM decisions. Evaluations using state-of-the-art 3D scene understanding models validate our proposed bounds and reveal a perception saturation phenomenon, indicating that improvements in perception accuracy beyond a certain threshold yield diminishing returns in navigation success. Our findings suggest that 3D scene understanding for VLN should pivot away from strict pixel-level precision, prioritizing instead navigation-relevant core vocabularies and accurate bounding box proportions.
tldr: This paper quantifies the impact of 3D scene understanding on zero-shot Vision-and-Language Navigation (VLN), revealing a perception saturation phenomenon and proposing a shift from pixel-level accuracy to navigation-relevant scene vocabularies.
tldr_zh: 本文量化了3D场景理解能力对零样本视觉语言导航性能的影响，揭示了感知饱和现象，并提出应从追求像素级精度转向关注导航相关的核心词汇和边界框比例。
summary_zh: 零样本视觉语言导航因其较低的数据收集成本与固有的泛化能力而受到广泛关注。该范式通常依赖于预训练视觉语言模型与大语言模型的融合——视觉语言模型负责构建三维场景图，而大语言模型则承担高层推理与决策任务。然而，当前系统存在一个关键瓶颈：现有的三维感知模型过度追求像素级精度，这与具身导航所要求的严格计算限制及实时效率需求直接冲突。为填补这一研究空白，本文量化分析了三维场景理解能力对视觉语言导航性能的实际影响。基于典型的视觉语言模型-大语言模型框架，我们提出了两个核心子系统的统计成功率上界：1）依赖拓扑地图语义的慢速大语言模型规划器；2）利用空间坐标与边界框执行大语言模型决策的快速反应导航器。通过使用前沿三维场景理解模型进行实验评估，我们验证了所提出的理论边界，并揭示了感知饱和现象：当感知精度超过特定阈值后，其对导航成功率的提升效益将逐渐递减。研究结果表明，视觉语言导航中的三维场景理解应转变思路，从追求严格的像素级精度转向聚焦于导航相关核心词汇与精确边界框比例的优化。

title: EARL: Towards a Unified Analysis-Guided Reinforcement Learning Framework for Egocentric Interaction Reasoning and Pixel Grounding
summary: Understanding human--environment interactions from egocentric vision is essential for assistive robotics and embodied intelligent agents, yet existing multimodal large language models (MLLMs) still struggle with accurate interaction reasoning and fine-grained pixel grounding. To this end, this paper introduces EARL, an Egocentric Analysis-guided Reinforcement Learning framework that explicitly transfers coarse interaction semantics to query-oriented answering and grounding. Specifically, EARL adopts a two-stage parsing framework including coarse-grained interpretation and fine-grained response. The first stage holistically interprets egocentric interactions and generates a structured textual description. The second stage produces the textual answer and pixel-level mask in response to the user query. To bridge the two stages, we extract a global interaction descriptor as a semantic prior, which is integrated via a novel Analysis-guided Feature Synthesizer (AFS) for query-oriented reasoning. To optimize heterogeneous outputs, including textual answers, bounding boxes, and grounding masks, we design a multi-faceted reward function and train the response stage with GRPO. Experiments on Ego-IRGBench show that EARL achieves 65.48% cIoU for pixel grounding, outperforming previous RL-based methods by 8.37%, while OOD grounding results on EgoHOS indicate strong transferability to unseen egocentric grounding scenarios.
tldr: EARL is a two-stage reinforcement learning framework that improves egocentric interaction reasoning and pixel grounding for assistive robotics and embodied agents, achieving state-of-the-art grounding results.
tldr_zh: EARL 是一个两阶段强化学习框架，通过分析引导的特征合成，提升了以自我为中心视觉的人-环境交互推理和像素级定位能力，适用于辅助机器人及具身智能体。
summary_zh: 从第一人称视角理解人与环境的交互对于辅助机器人与具身智能体至关重要，然而现有的多模态大语言模型在精准交互推理与细粒度像素定位方面仍存在局限。为此，本文提出EARL框架——一种以自我中心分析引导的强化学习方法，其显式地将粗粒度交互语义转化为面向查询的应答与定位。该框架采用包含粗粒度解析与细粒度响应的两阶段分析结构：第一阶段整体解析第一人称交互并生成结构化文本描述；第二阶段则针对用户查询生成文本答案与像素级掩膜。为衔接两个阶段，我们提取全局交互描述符作为语义先验，并通过新型的"分析引导特征合成器"将其整合到面向查询的推理过程中。针对文本答案、边界框及定位掩膜等异构输出，我们设计了多维度奖励函数，并采用GRPO算法对响应阶段进行训练。在Ego-IRGBench数据集上的实验表明，EARL在像素定位任务中达到65.48%的cIoU指标，较以往基于强化学习的方法提升8.37%；同时在EgoHOS数据集上的跨域定位结果验证了该框架对未见第一人称定位场景的强泛化能力。

title: DiffPhD: A Unified Differentiable Solver for Projective Heterogeneous Materials in Elastodynamics with Contact-Rich GPU-Acceleration
summary: Differentiable simulation of soft bodies is a foundation for system identification, trajectory optimization, and Real2Sim transfer. Yet, existing methods such as the differentiable Projective Dynamics (DiffPD) struggle when faced with heterogeneous materials with extreme stiffness contrasts, hyperelasticity under large deformations, and contact-rich interactions, which are common scenarios in the real world. We present DiffPhD, a unified GPU-accelerated differentiable Projective Dynamics framework for heterogeneous materials that tackles these intertwined challenges simultaneously. Our key insight is a careful integration of: (i) stiffness-aware projective weights to embed heterogeneity into the global system; (ii) trust-region eigenvalue filtering lifted to the backward pass for stable hyperelastic gradients and a type-II Anderson Acceleration scheme with dual-gate convergence to stabilize forward iteration under large stiffness contrasts; and (iii) a unified GPU pipeline that reuses a single sparse factor across forward, backward, and contact computations, with stiffness-amplified Rayleigh damping folded into the same factor for heterogeneity-aware dissipation at zero recurring cost. DiffPhD achieves strict gradient accuracy while delivering up to an order-of-magnitude speedup over prior differentiable solvers on heterogeneous, hyperelastic, contact-rich benchmarks. Crucially, this speedup does not come at the cost of stability: DiffPhD remains convergent on stiffness contrasts up to 100x where prior PD solvers degrade. This unlocks end-to-end gradient-based optimization on regimes previously bottlenecked by either solver fragility or per-iteration cost -- shell--joint composite creatures, soft characters wielding stiff weapons, and soft-gripper robotic manipulation -- all handled within a single forward--backward pass.
tldr: DiffPhD is a GPU-accelerated differentiable physics simulator for heterogeneous, hyperelastic, and contact-rich materials, enabling efficient gradient-based optimization for applications like soft robotic manipulation.
tldr_zh: DiffPhD 是一个用于异质、超弹性和接触丰富材料的GPU加速可微分物理模拟器，可为软体机器人抓取等应用实现高效的梯度优化。
summary_zh: 可微软体仿真是系统辨识、轨迹优化以及Real2Sim（从真实到仿真）迁移的基础技术。然而，现有方法如可微投影动力学在应对现实世界中常见的极端刚度对比异质材料、大变形下的超弹性以及密集接触交互时存在明显不足。本文提出DiffPhD，一种针对异质材料的统一GPU加速可微投影动力学框架，能够同时应对这些交织的挑战。我们的核心见解在于精心整合以下三方面：(i) 刚度感知投影权重，将材料异质性嵌入全局系统；(ii) 采用提升至反向传播的信任域特征值滤波技术以稳定超弹性梯度计算，并结合具备双门收敛判据的II型安德森加速算法，在大刚度差异条件下稳定前向迭代；(iii) 构建统一GPU流水线，在前向传播、反向传播与接触计算中复用单一稀疏矩阵因子，并将刚度放大的瑞利阻尼折叠至同一因子中，实现零额外成本的异质感知耗散计算。DiffPhD在保证严格梯度精度的同时，在异质材料、超弹性、密集接触的基准测试中相较现有可微求解器实现最高一个数量级的加速。尤为关键的是，该加速并未牺牲稳定性：在刚度对比高达100倍的场景下，DiffPhD仍能保持收敛，而传统投影动力学求解器性能已显著退化。这一突破使得此前受求解器脆弱性或单步计算成本限制的领域——如壳-关节复合生物、持握刚性武器的软体角色、软体夹爪机器人操控等——均能通过单一前向-反向传播实现端到端的梯度优化。

title: Safety-Constrained Reinforcement Learning with Post-Training Reachability Verification for Robot Navigation
summary: Safe navigation for mobile robots demands policies that remain reliable under the high-consequence perception uncertainty of cluttered environments. Yet most existing safe reinforcement learning (RL) methods assess safety through average cumulative cost. Such metrics can mask dangerous tail-risk behaviors. To address this, we propose a framework that trains risk-sensitive policies through Conditional Value-at-Risk (CVaR) constrained optimization on an off-policy TD3 backbone and evaluates their safety margins post-training through neural network reachability verification. During training, the policy is optimized under CVaR constraints on cumulative costs, promoting sensitivity to high-cost tail outcomes rather than average behavior alone. After training, we compute action reachable sets under bounded observation uncertainty using Taylor Model analysis, yielding a safety rate metric that quantifies the proportion of evaluated states at which the policy's reachable action set remains within prescribed safety margins. A key finding is that policies trained with CVaR constraints maintain larger safety margins from obstacles across evaluated states. This makes them significantly more amenable to formal reachability verification. Experiments across ten navigation scenarios and six baselines show that our method achieves a 98.3\% success rate, the highest safety verification rate among all compared methods, while revealing that average cost rankings and reachability-based safety rankings can diverge. This indicates that reachability verification captures risks which are missed by empirical cost metrics alone. We further validate our approach on a physical Clearpath Jackal robot, demonstrating successful sim-to-real transfer.
tldr: The paper proposes a framework for training risk-sensitive robot navigation policies using CVaR-constrained RL and verifies their safety post-training via neural network reachability analysis.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了一个用于训练风险敏感机器人导航策略的框架，使用CVaR约束的强化学习，并通过神经网络可达性分析在训练后验证其安全性。
summary_zh: 移动机器人的安全导航需要策略能够在杂乱环境中高后果感知不确定性的情况下保持可靠。然而大多数现有的安全强化学习方法通过平均累积成本来评估安全性这种度量方式可能掩盖危险的尾部风险行为。为解决这一问题我们提出一种框架：在离策略TD3算法基础上通过条件风险价值约束优化训练风险敏感策略并在训练后通过神经网络可达性验证评估其安全裕度。训练过程中策略在累积成本的CVaR约束下进行优化从而提升对高成本尾部结果的敏感性而非仅关注平均行为。训练完成后我们采用泰勒模型分析在有界观测不确定性下计算动作可达集生成安全率指标该指标量化了策略可达动作集保持在预设安全边界内的评估状态比例。关键发现是：经CVaR约束训练的策略在评估状态下能保持更大的障碍物安全距离使其显著更适合进行形式化可达性验证。在十种导航场景和六种基线方法的实验表明我们的方法实现了98.3%的成功率在所有对比方法中达到最高的安全验证率同时揭示平均成本排名与基于可达性的安全排名可能发生偏离。这表明可达性验证能够捕捉仅凭经验成本度量所遗漏的风险。我们进一步在Clearpath Jackal物理机器人上验证了该方法成功实现了从仿真到现实的迁移。

title: SToRe3D: Sparse Token Relevance in ViTs for Efficient Multi-View 3D Object Detection
summary: Vision Transformers (ViTs) enable strong multi-view 3D detection but are limited by high inference latency from dense token and query processing across multiple views and large 3D regions. Existing sparsity methods, designed mainly for 2D vision, prune or merge image tokens but do not extend to full-model sparsity or address 3D object queries. We introduce SToRe3D, a relevance-aligned sparsity framework that jointly selects 2D image tokens and 3D object queries while storing filtered features for reactivation. Mutual 2D-3D relevance heads allocate compute to driving-critical content and preserve other embeddings. Evaluated on nuScenes and our new nuScenes-Relevance benchmark, SToRe3D achieves up to 3x faster inference with marginal accuracy loss, establishing real-time large-scale ViT-based 3D detection while maintaining accuracy on planning-critical agents.
tldr: SToRe3D introduces a relevance-aligned sparsity framework for efficient multi-view 3D object detection, jointly pruning 2D tokens and 3D queries to achieve up to 3x faster inference for driving-critical content.
tldr_zh: SToRe3D 提出一种相关性对齐的稀疏框架，用于高效多视角3D目标检测，联合修剪2D图像令牌和3D查询，为驾驶关键内容实现高达3倍的推理加速。
summary_zh: 摘要：视觉变换器在强大的多视角三维检测中展现出优异性能，但其密集化的跨视角标记与三维空间查询处理导致推理延迟较高。现有稀疏化方法主要针对二维视觉任务设计，虽能剪枝或融合图像标记，却无法扩展至全模型稀疏化，亦未解决三维物体查询的优化问题。我们提出SToRe3D——一种基于相关性对齐的稀疏化框架，能够联合筛选二维图像标记与三维物体查询，同时存储过滤后的特征以供重新激活。双向二维-三维相关性评估模块将计算资源集中于驾驶关键内容，并保留其他特征嵌入。在nuScenes数据集及我们新构建的nuScenes-Relevance基准测试中，SToRe3D在保持规划关键目标检测精度的前提下，实现了最高3倍的推理加速，仅伴随微小精度损失，由此建立了基于视觉变换器的实时大规模三维检测系统。

title: Behavior Cloning for Active Perception with Low-Resolution Egocentric Vision
summary: We investigate whether behavior cloning is sufficient to produce active perception in a structured object-finding task. A low-cost robot arm equipped with a wrist-mounted egocentric RGB camera must reposition to center a partially visible plant before triggering a grasp signal, requiring actions that improve future observations. The model predicts joint commands directly from low-resolution RGB images under closed-loop control. We show that low-resolution egocentric vision is sufficient for reliable task completion and that predicting relative joint deltas substantially outperforms absolute joint position prediction in our setting. These results demonstrate that visually grounded active perception can emerge from behavior cloning in a reproducible setting.
tldr: Behavior cloning with low-resolution egocentric RGB vision enables a robot arm to perform active perception for object-finding and grasping, showing that predicting joint deltas outperforms absolute position prediction.
tldr_zh: 使用低分辨率第一视角RGB视觉的行为克隆使机械臂能够执行主动感知以进行物体寻找和抓取，结果表明预测关节增量优于绝对位置预测。
summary_zh: 本研究探讨了行为克隆是否足以在结构化物体寻找任务中实现主动感知。我们使用配备腕部第一视角RGB摄像头的低成本机械臂，要求在触发抓取信号前通过调整位置将部分可见的植物居中，这一过程需要执行能优化后续观测的动作。该模型在闭环控制下直接根据低分辨率RGB图像预测关节指令。实验表明，低分辨率的第一视角视觉足以可靠完成该任务，且在我们的设定中，预测相对关节增量显著优于绝对关节位置预测。这些结果表明，基于视觉的主动感知能力能够在可复现环境中通过行为克隆自然涌现。

title: Ergodic Imitation for Adaptive Exploration around Demonstrations
summary: In robotics, a common challenge in imitation learning is the mismatch between training and deployment conditions, caused, for example, by environmental changes or imperfect observation and control. When a robot follows a nominal trajectory under such mismatch, it may become stuck and fail to complete the task. This calls for adaptive online exploration strategies that remain grounded in demonstrations. To this end, we propose an adaptive ergodic imitation approach that constructs a target distribution from the geometry of the retrieved demonstrations and uses it to generate trajectories that adaptively interpolate between tracking and exploration. Our method extends ergodic control beyond its traditional role in area-coverage and search by incorporating demonstrations into a retrieval-based receding-horizon framework for adaptive imitation.
tldr: The paper proposes an adaptive ergodic imitation method that uses a retrieval-based receding-horizon framework to generate trajectories that interpolate between tracking demonstrations and exploration, addressing deployment condition mismatches in robotics.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出一种自适应遍历模仿方法，它使用基于检索的滚动时域框架来生成轨迹，在跟踪演示和探索之间进行插值，以解决机器人学中的部署条件不匹配问题。
summary_zh: 在机器人学中，模仿学习面临的一个常见挑战是训练与部署条件之间的不匹配，这通常由环境变化、观测不完善或控制不精准等因素引起。当机器人在此种不匹配条件下遵循预设轨迹时，它可能陷入停滞状态而无法完成任务。为此，需要一种基于示范动作、具备自适应性的在线探索策略。针对这一需求，我们提出一种自适应遍历模仿方法。该方法基于检索到的示范动作的几何结构构建目标分布，并利用该分布生成能够在轨迹跟踪与探索行为之间自适应调整的路径。我们的方法将遍历控制从传统的区域覆盖与搜索任务扩展至模仿学习领域，通过将示范动作纳入基于检索的滚动时域框架中，实现了自适应模仿。

title: Coding Agent Is Good As World Simulator
summary: World models have emerged as a powerful paradigm for building interactive simulation environments, with recent video-based approaches demonstrating impressive progress in generating visually plausible dynamics. However, because these models typically infer dynamics from video and represent them in latent states, they do not explicitly enforce physical constraints. As a result, the generated video rollouts are not physically plausible, exhibiting unstable contacts, distorted shapes, or inconsistent motion. In this paper, we present an agentic framework constructing physics-based world models through executable simulation code. The framework coordinates planning, code generation, visual review, and physics analysis agents. The planning agent converts the natural language prompt into a structured scene plan, the code agent implements it as executable simulation code, and the visual review agent provide visual feedback while the physics analysis agent checks physical consistency. The code is iteratively revised based on the feedback until the simulation matches the prompt reqirements and physical constraints. Experimental results show that our framework outperforms advanced video-based models in physical accuracy, instruction fidelity and visual quality, which could be applied to various scenarios including driving simulation and embodied robot tasks.
tldr: Proposes an agentic framework that constructs physics-based world models through executable simulation code, outperforming video-based models in physical accuracy, instruction fidelity, and visual quality.
tldr_zh: 提出了一个代理框架，通过可执行模拟代码构建基于物理的世界模型，在物理准确性、指令保真度和视觉质量上优于基于视频的模型。
summary_zh: 世界模型已成为构建交互式仿真环境的一种强大范式，近期基于视频的方法在生成视觉合理的动态效果方面展现出显著进展。然而，由于这些模型通常从视频中推断动态信息并将其表征于潜在状态中，它们未能显式地强制执行物理约束。因此，生成的视频序列在物理层面上缺乏合理性，常出现不稳定的接触、扭曲的形态或不一致的运动。本文提出一种基于智能体的框架，通过可执行仿真代码构建物理世界模型。该框架协调规划、代码生成、视觉审查与物理分析智能体：规划智能体将自然语言提示转换为结构化场景方案，代码智能体将其实现为可执行仿真代码，视觉审查智能体提供视觉反馈，物理分析智能体则校验物理一致性。代码将根据反馈进行迭代修正，直至仿真结果符合提示要求与物理约束。实验表明，我们的框架在物理准确性、指令遵循度和视觉质量上均优于先进的视频生成模型，可应用于驾驶仿真与具身机器人任务等多种场景。

title: Causal Forcing++: Scalable Few-Step Autoregressive Diffusion Distillation for Real-Time Interactive Video Generation
summary: Real-time interactive video generation requires low-latency, streaming, and controllable rollout. Existing autoregressive (AR) diffusion distillation methods have achieved strong results in the chunk-wise 4-step regime by distilling bidirectional base models into few-step AR students, but they remain limited by coarse response granularity and non-negligible sampling latency. In this paper, we study a more aggressive setting: frame-wise autoregression with only 1--2 sampling steps. In this regime, we identify the initialization of a few-step AR student as the key bottleneck: existing strategies are either target-misaligned, incapable of few-step generation, or too costly to scale. We propose \textbf{Causal Forcing++}, a principled and scalable pipeline that uses \emph{causal consistency distillation} (causal CD) for few-step AR initialization. The core idea is that causal CD learns the same AR-conditional flow map as causal ODE distillation, but obtains supervision from a single online teacher ODE step between adjacent timesteps, avoiding the need to precompute and store full PF-ODE trajectories. This makes the initialization both more efficient and easier to optimize. The resulting pipeline, \ours, surpasses the SOTA 4-step chunk-wise Causal Forcing under the \textit{\textbf{frame-wise 2-step setting}} by 0.1 in VBench Total, 0.3 in VBench Quality, and 0.335 in VisionReward, while reducing first-frame latency by 50\% and Stage 2 training cost by $\sim$$4\times$. We further extend the pipeline to action-conditioned world model generation in the spirit of Genie3. Project Page: https://github.com/thu-ml/Causal-Forcing and https://github.com/shengshu-ai/minWM .
tldr: Proposes Causal Forcing++, a scalable distillation method for real-time, few-step autoregressive video generation, extending to action-conditioned world models.
tldr_zh: 提出了 Causal Forcing++，一种用于实时、少步自回归视频生成的可扩展蒸馏方法，并扩展到动作条件世界模型生成。
summary_zh: 实时交互式视频生成需要具备低延迟、流式传输和可控推演能力。现有的自回归扩散蒸馏方法通过将双向基础模型蒸馏为少步数自回归学生模型，在分块式4步采样机制中取得了显著成果，但其仍受限于响应粒度粗糙和不可忽略的采样延迟。本文研究一种更激进的设定：仅需1-2采样步数的逐帧自回归机制。在此设定下，我们发现少步数自回归学生模型的初始化是关键瓶颈：现有策略存在目标未对齐、无法实现少步数生成或计算成本过高而难以扩展等问题。为此，我们提出**Causal Forcing++**——一种基于原则且可扩展的流程，采用**因果一致性蒸馏**进行少步数自回归模型初始化。其核心思想在于，因果一致性蒸馏学习与因果ODE蒸馏相同的自回归条件流映射，但通过相邻时间步间单次在线教师ODE步长获取监督信号，从而避免了预计算和存储完整PF-ODE轨迹的需求。这使得初始化过程兼具更高效率和更优的优化特性。所提流程在**逐帧2步采样设定**下，以VBench总分0.1分、VBench质量分0.3分、VisionReward分0.335分的优势超越当前最优的4步分块式Causal Forcing方法，同时将首帧延迟降低50%，第二阶段训练成本减少约4倍。我们进一步将该流程扩展至基于Genie3思想的动作条件世界模型生成领域。项目页面：https://github.com/thu-ml/Causal-Forcing 与 https://github.com/shengshu-ai/minWM 。

title: DriveCtrl: Conditioned Sim-to-Real Driving Video Generation
summary: Large-scale labelled driving video data is essential for training autonomous driving systems. Although simulation offers scalable and fully annotated data, the domain gap between synthetic and real-world driving videos significantly limits its utility for downstream deployment. Existing video generation methods are not well-suited for this task, as they fail to simultaneously preserve scene structure, object dynamics, temporal consistency, and visual realism, all of which are critical for maintaining annotation validity in generated data. In this paper, we present DriveCtrl, a depth-conditioned controllable sim-to-real video generation framework for realistic driving video synthesis. Built upon a pretrained video foundation model, DriveCtrl introduces a structure-aware adapter that enables depth-guided generation while preserving the scene layout and motion patterns of the source simulation, producing temporally coherent driving videos that remain aligned with the original simulated sequences. We further introduce a scalable data generation pipeline that transforms simulator videos into realistic driving footage matching the visual style of a target real-world dataset. The pipeline supports three conditioning signals: structural depth, reference-dataset style, and text prompts, while preserving frame-level annotations for downstream perception tasks. To better assess this task, we propose a driving-domain-specific knowledge-informed evaluation metric called Driving Video Realism Score (DVRS) that assesses the realism of generated videos. Experiments demonstrate that DriveCtrl consistently outperforms the base model and competing alternatives in realism, temporal quality, and perception task performance, substantially narrowing the sim-to-real gap for driving video generation.
tldr: DriveCtrl is a depth-conditioned controllable sim-to-real video generation framework for realistic driving video synthesis, narrowing the sim-to-real gap while preserving frame-level annotations for downstream perception tasks.
tldr_zh: DriveCtrl是一个用于真实驾驶视频合成的深度条件可控的仿真到真实视频生成框架，缩小了仿真到现实的差距，同时保留了用于下游感知任务的帧级注释。
summary_zh: 大规模带标注的驾驶视频数据对训练自动驾驶系统至关重要。尽管仿真能够提供可扩展且全标注的数据，但合成数据与真实驾驶视频之间的领域差异显著限制了其在下游部署中的应用价值。现有视频生成方法难以同时满足场景结构保持、物体动态还原、时间连贯性及视觉真实感等关键要求，而这些因素对于生成数据中标注有效性的维持至关重要。本文提出DriveCtrl框架，这是一种基于深度条件控制、面向真实驾驶视频合成的仿真到现实视频生成方案。该框架基于预训练视频基础模型构建，通过引入结构感知适配器实现深度引导生成，在保持源仿真场景布局与运动模式的同时，生成时间连贯且与原始仿真序列对齐的驾驶视频。我们进一步设计了可扩展的数据生成流程，能够将仿真器视频转化为符合目标真实数据集视觉风格的逼真驾驶影像。该流程支持结构深度、参考数据集风格与文本提示三种控制信号，同时保持帧级标注信息以支持下游感知任务。针对该任务的评估需求，我们提出了专用于驾驶领域的知识感知评估指标——驾驶视频真实度评分（DVRS），用于量化生成视频的真实性。实验表明，DriveCtrl在真实感、时间连贯性及感知任务性能上均显著优于基础模型与竞争方法，极大缩小了驾驶视频生成领域的仿真与现实差距。

title: SOCC-ICP: Semantics-Assisted Odometry based on Occupancy Grids and ICP
summary: Reliable pose estimation in previously unseen environments is a fundamental capability of autonomous systems. Existing LiDAR odometry methods typically employ point-, surfel-, or NDT-based map representations, which are distinct from the semantic occupancy grids commonly used for downstream tasks such as motion planning. We introduce SOCC-ICP, a semantics-assisted odometry framework that jointly performs Semantic OCCupancy grid mapping and LiDAR scan alignment. Each map voxel encodes geometric and semantic statistics, enabling adaptive point-to-point or point-to-plane ICP based on local planarity. Further, the occupancy grid naturally filters dynamic objects through raycasting-based free-space updates. Across diverse evaluation scenarios, SOCC-ICP achieves performance competitive with state-of-the-art LiDAR odometry and remains robust in geometrically degenerate environments, even in the absence of semantic cues. When semantic labels are available, integrating them into map construction, downsampling, and correspondence weighting yields further accuracy gains. By unifying odometry and semantic occupancy grid mapping within a single representation, SOCC-ICP eliminates redundant map structures and directly provides a map suitable for downstream robotic applications.
tldr: Proposes a semantics-assisted LiDAR odometry framework that jointly performs semantic occupancy grid mapping and scan alignment, improving robustness and providing a map directly usable for downstream robotics tasks.
tldr_zh: 提出了一种语义辅助的LiDAR里程计框架，联合执行语义占据栅格建图与扫描匹配，提高了鲁棒性并直接提供适用于下游机器人任务的建图结果。
summary_zh: 在未知环境中实现可靠的姿态估计是自主系统的一项基本能力。现有的激光雷达里程计方法通常采用基于点、面元或正态分布变换的地图表示方式，这与下游任务（如运动规划）中常用的语义占据栅格存在显著差异。我们提出了SOCC-ICP，一种语义辅助的里程计框架，能够同时执行语义占据栅格建图和激光雷达扫描对齐。每个地图体素均编码几何与语义统计信息，支持基于局部平面性进行自适应点对点或点对平面的ICP配准。此外，占据栅格通过基于光线投射的自由空间更新，天然实现对动态物体的过滤。在多种评估场景中，SOCC-ICP达到了与先进激光雷达里程计方法相竞争的性能，即使在缺乏语义信息的情况下，也能在几何退化环境中保持稳健性。当可获得语义标签时，将其融入地图构建、下采样及对应关系加权过程可进一步提升精度。通过将里程计与语义占据栅格建图统一于单一表示中，SOCC-ICP消除了冗余的地图结构，并直接提供了适用于下游机器人应用的地图。

title: CaMeRL: Collision-Aware and Memory-Enhanced Reinforcement Learning for UAV Navigation in Multi-Scale Obstacle Environments
summary: In obstacle avoidance navigation of unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs), variations in obstacle scale have received strangely less attention than obstacle number or density. Existing methods typically extract purely geometric features from single-frame depth observations. Such representations tend to neglect small obstacles and lose spatial context under occlusions caused by large obstacles, leading to noticeable degradation in environments with multi-scale obstacles. To address this issue, we propose CaMeRL, a Collision-aware and Memory-enhanced Reinforcement Learning framework for UAV navigation. The collision-aware latent representation encodes risk-sensitive depth cues to preserve fine-grained obstacle structures, thereby improving sensitivity to small obstacles. The temporal memory module integrates observations across frames, mitigating partial observability caused by large-obstacle occlusions. We evaluate CaMeRL with multi-scale obstacles, including ultra-small and extra-large obstacle settings. Results show that CaMeRL outperforms state-of-the-art baselines across all scales, with success rate gains of 0.48 and 0.28 in the ultra-small and extra-large settings, respectively. More importantly, CaMeRL achieves reliable navigation in cluttered outdoor environments.
tldr: Proposes CaMeRL, a reinforcement learning framework for UAV navigation that uses a collision-aware representation for small obstacles and a temporal memory module to handle occlusions from large obstacles, improving performance in multi-scale obstacle environments.
tldr_zh: 提出CaMeRL，一个用于无人机导航的强化学习框架，它使用碰撞感知表示来处理小障碍物，并利用时序记忆模块处理大障碍物遮挡，从而在多尺度障碍物环境中提高性能。
